cohort: Singleton deliveries born between 1991 and 2021 in a tertiary medical center, with offspring followed until 18 years of age.
finding: Maternal FMF was independently associated with preterm delivery, cesarean delivery, low birth weight, and a significantly higher rate of long-term infection-related hospitalization in the offspring.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was independently associated with maternal FMF.
followup_time: Up to 18 years, with a mean follow-up of 9.7 years (SD = 6.2).
